analysis.title: Occidental Petroleum Corp. (OXY): Takeaways from Houston: Self-Help Story On Track; Maintain Buy (on Conviction List)
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on OXY, which is on its Conviction List, and cuts the 12-month price target to $75 from $76. The price was $56.52, implying 32.7% upside. The basis is a long-term $75 Brent and $70 WTI oil environment.
GS sees OXY as one of the best self-help stories. It estimates a $4 billion cash flow uplift by 2029 from operating cost reductions, interest savings and improvements in decline rates.
3Q26 produced about $2.8 bn of free cash flow on stronger-than-expected production and continued capital discipline.

OXY reached its $10.0 bn principal debt milestone and set a new $6.0 bn target. Management expects to reach it during 2027 at mid-cycle or current strip pricing. GS models it by YE2027 at $80/bbl Brent and $3.00/MMBtu Henry Hub.

At $6.0 bn of principal debt, OXY expects leverage of about 1.0x at $50/bbl WTI and annual interest expense of about $400 mn, roughly $1.0 bn below 2025. Management sees this as the step that expands capacity for dividend growth and broader shareholder returns.
Management plans to evaluate opportunistic share repurchases after reaching $6.0 bn and ahead of the preferred equity redemption in August 2029.

GS wants more clarity on 2027 capital spending relative to the $5.9 bn starting point messaged earlier this year. The preliminary outlook includes peak Horn Mountain waterflood spending and modest exploration in Trinidad and Tobago, Peru and Colombia.

Advanced recovery progress: conventional EOR sidetracks and conventional horizontal wells added roughly 10-11 Mboe/d. Management has identified about 500 more sidetrack opportunities and still expects 100 sidetracks completed by YE2026.

OXY announced agreements for about 2 MTPA of lower-cost aggregated CO2 for Permian EOR, expandable to about 4 MTPA. CO2 and power are about 30% of the cost of an EOR barrel, so cheaper supply should improve project economics.

3Q26 oil and total production were 697/1,427 Mboe/d, about 7 Mboe/d above the guidance midpoint on U.S. onshore outperformance. Gulf of America volumes lost 9 Mboe/d to a third-party gas pipeline outage and extended maintenance.
4Q26 oil production guidance of about 694-713 Mbo/d is below GS and FactSet consensus. It includes the Gulf of America pipeline constraint and downtime from an early-October hurricane.
Midstream and marketing earned $309 mn adjusted pre-tax income in 3Q26 on higher sulfur prices and sales volumes at Al Hosn. Management guides 4Q26 pre-tax midstream income to $100-$200 mn.
STRATOS retains startup execution risk while OXY completes structural repairs and commissioning. Management expects full plant startup around year-end 2026 and $90-$130 mn of project EBITDA in 2028.

Valuation: $75 target uses a 10.0% target free cash flow yield on 2028 estimates at $75/bbl Brent and $3.50/MMBtu Henry Hub. GS weights 85% to a fundamental value of about $73 and 15% to an M&A value of about $84 (M&A rank 2). The cut reflects moving to 2028 FCF at $75 Brent from an average of 2027/2028 FCF at about $78 Brent.

market_movers.rationale: Buy reiterated and on the GS Conviction List, with the 12-month target cut to $75 from $76. GS cites accelerated deleveraging and growing sustainable cash flow.

earnings_insights: OXY reported 3Q26 results: free cash flow of about $2.8 bn (reported), oil and total production of 697/1,427 Mboe/d, about 7 Mboe/d above the guidance midpoint.
3Q26 midstream and marketing adjusted pre-tax income was $309 mn (reported). 4Q26 pre-tax midstream income guidance is $100-$200 mn.
4Q26 oil production guidance of about 694-713 Mbo/d is below GS and FactSet consensus estimates.

GS estimates, diluted EPS pre-exceptionals: 2026E $7.30 (new) vs $6.85 (old), 2027E $4.67 vs $4.79, 2028E $4.39 vs $4.21. These are GS forecasts, not reported figures. 2025 actual diluted EPS pre-exceptionals was $2.23.
GS forecasts 2026E free cash flow of $7,473.6 mn, 2027E $7,590.4 mn and 2028E $7,511.5 mn. 2025 free cash flow was $3,032 mn.
